rules.statement: The plaintiff must establish due registration and valuable consideration for his deed to succeed in the suit.
rules.supporting_quote: "Even if, as appears to be the case, deed D. 2 has not been duly registered as required by the Ordinance the plaintiff to succeed in the suit had to establish (a) that his later deed P. 4 was duly registered and (b) that there was valuable consideration for the transfer to him."
